Esse profissional atua como referência técnica da área, combinando visão estratégica, liderança técnica e execução, assegurando que os dados estejam disponíveis, confiáveis e prontos para suportar decisões de negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades


Liderança Técnica

  • Liderar tecnicamente o time de dados e BI
  • Definir padrões técnicos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Realizar revisões de arquitetura e código (code review)
  • Orientar e desenvolver os membros do time
  • Apoiar a priorização técnica das demandas
  • Garantir qualidade, performance e segurança das soluções
  • Atuar como referência técnica da área
  • Apoiar a resolução de incidentes críticos
  • Garantir a evolução contínua da plataforma de dados


Arquitetura de Dados

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de dados baseada em Data Lake
  • Implementar e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis e resilientes
  • Estruturar e governar o modelo de dados baseado em camadas:

Raw (Bronze)

Dados brutos ingeridos dos sistemas de origem

Silver

Dados tratados, padronizados e validados

Gold

Dados consolidados e prontos para análise e consumo

  • Definir padrões de ingestão, transformação e armazenamento de dados
  • Garantir qualidade, integridade e rastreabilidade dos dados
  • Definir estratégias de versionamento e lineage de dados


Cloud e Big Data (AWS)

Responsável por projetar e operar soluções de dados utilizando:

  • S3
  • Glue
  • Athena
  • EMR
  • Lambda
  • Step Functions
  • Kinesis
  • SQS / SNS
  • RDS / Aurora
  • DynamoDB


Observabilidade e Confiabilidade de Dados

  • Implementar práticas de Data Observability
  • Monitorar pipelines de dados em tempo real
  • Criar alertas proativos para falhas e degradação de performance
  • Garantir rastreabilidade ponta a ponta dos dados
  • Monitorar SLA e latência de pipelines
  • Implementar métricas de confiabilidade e disponibilidade


Ferramentas típicas:

  • Datadog
  • CloudWatch
  • Grafana
  • Prometheus
  • OpenTelemetry


Business Intelligence e Analytics

  • Garantir a consistência dos indicadores e dashboards
  • Definir modelos de dados analíticos
  • Garantir performance de consultas e datasets
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na definição de KPIs
  • Garantir governança e qualidade dos dados analíticos


Ferramentas típicas:

  • Power BI
  • Lovable


Uso de Inteligência Artificial em Dados

  • Implementar soluções de IA generativa para análise de dados
  • Automatizar geração de insights e relatórios
  • Implementar análise conversacional de dados
  • Integrar modelos de IA à plataforma de dados
  • Garantir governança e segurança no uso de IA para dados


Responsabilidades Operacionais

  • Planejar e acompanhar entregas técnicas do time
  • Distribuir demandas técnicas
  • Garantir cumprimento de padrões e arquitetura
  • Apoiar planejamento técnico das sprints
  • Identificar riscos técnicos e propor mitigação
  • Garantir estabilidade da plataforma de dados
  • Atuar em incidentes críticos


Habilidades Técnicas Obrigatórias


Dados e Arquitetura

  • Arquitetura de Data Lake
  • Modelagem de dados
  • ETL / ELT
  • SQL avançado
  • Python
  • Big Data
  • Governança de dados


Cloud

  • Experiência sólida com AWS
  • Arquitetura em cloud
  • Processamento distribuído
  • Orquestração de pipelines


Observabilidade

  • Monitoramento de pipelines
  • Logs e métricas
  • Alertas e incidentes
  • Confiabilidade de dados

title: Senior Buyer
description:
Senior Buyer (Indirect Procurement)


A global organization is hiring a Senior Buyer to join its Indirect Category team. This role supports a wide range of indirect spend categories (e.g., travel, corporate services, facilities, IT services, training, uniforms/workwear, and other business services), partnering closely with internal stakeholders and suppliers to deliver an efficient end-to-end purchasing experience. The ideal candidate is a highly organized, detail-oriented team player who will oversee the entire order process.



What you’ll do:

  • Manage day-to-day purchasing for assigned countries via a PO/requisition system, including processing requisitions in Workday.
  • Source suppliers, obtain quotes, negotiate, and ensure preferred suppliers are used.
  • Maintain supplier catalogs for repetitive purchases and manage open orders to ensure timely delivery/receiving in the system.
  • Build procurement reports/dashboards and partner with accounts payable to resolve invoice issues.
  • Lead local sourcing projects and negotiate contracts.
  • You will review proposals, negotiate prices, select the best suppliers, analyze trends, follow up with placed orders, verify delivery, approve payment, and maintain necessary records.
  • Perform commercial analysis on suppliers to develop more efficient processes and cost-effective solutions


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in purchasing, inventory, or supply chain management
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • 5+ years in Procurement / Buying / Supply Chain;
  • Strong stakeholder management, ethics, and reporting skills
  • Advanced Excel/PowerPoint/Word.
  • Comfortable in a fast-changing environment; international travel may be required.
  • Proficiency in English is mandatory for this position.


Interested? Apply with your CV and a brief summary of your indirect procurement experience (categories, systems, especially Workday, and typical contract values).


Company details shared with shortlisted candidates only.

title: Career Framework Specialist
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cut-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the Role:


The Career Framework Specialist plays a crucial role in designing and maintaining organizational talent structures, translating complex role dynamics into clear, scalable career paths. You'll bring clarity to organizational complexity by crafting intuitive job architectures that support talent growth and alignment.


Key Responsibilities:


- Designing and maintaining career paths, leveling frameworks, and job families for Talent roles.

- Building and updating role definitions, responsibilities, and seniority distinctions.

- Ensuring consistency, clarity, and scalability across all Talent-related structures.

- Partnering with Talent Acquisition Leaders to align role frameworks with business needs.

- Documenting and communicating updates in a clear, structured, and globally usable way.

- Supporting audits and Talent processes by keeping role architectures accurate and standardized.


Requirements:


- Experience: 3+ years in Organizational Development, Talent Management, HR Business Analysis, or Job Architecture.

- Design Skills: Proven experience designing career paths, job families, or role architectures.

- Analytical Ability: Strong capability to analyze and structure information into clear frameworks.

- Communication: Excellent written communication and documentation skills.

- Collaboration: Experience working with cross-functional HR or Talent teams.

- Technical Skills: Advanced experience with Excel/Google Sheets and documentation tools.


Desired Tools Experience:


- Documentation platforms like Notion or Confluence.

- Flowchart/mapping tools such as Miro or Lucidchart.


Personal Attributes:


- Systems and structural thinking.

- Passion for clarity and logical problem-solving.

- Ability to translate complex information into intuitive frameworks.

- Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

- Skill in collaborating across multiple stakeholders.


What to Expect from Us:


- Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world.

- Competitive Compensation: Excellent payment in USD or your preferred local currency.

- Home Office Setup: Complete hardware provision for your workspace.

- Flexible Hours: Design your own work schedule for optimal work-life balance.

- Paid Leave: Parental leave, vacation, and national holidays.

- Dynamic Work Culture: Innovative and multicultural environment.

- Elite Collaboration: Work with the global top 1% of talent.

- Growth and Support: Mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, do not hesitate to apply!


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Portuguese Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and skilled Gen AI Data Annotation Analysts to join our global remote teams. Analysts will perform annotations across various modalities—including text, image, and video—to deliver high-quality datasets essential for training and refining cutting- edge Generative AI models.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Annotate high-quality training data across text, image, and video modalities, adhering strictly to provided project guidelines.
  • Generate accurate data annotation as per project requirements.
  • Apply critical thinking and logical decision-making when handling ambiguous data scenarios.
  • Proactively identify and report annotation tool issues, bugs, or potential improvements.
  • Collaborate with Language Leads, Project Managers, and technical teams to ensure annotation tasks meet quality standards.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong analytical skills for identifying inaccuracies and ensuring annotation precision.
  • Proficiency in adapting to various project specifications and guidelines.
  • Excellent reading comprehension skills in the target language equivalent to CEFR B2 and above.
  • Strong organizational skills, capable of managing multiple annotation tasks efficiently and independently.
  • Comfort handling social media content, demonstrating proficiency at a minimum of understanding PII and NER related content.
  • Ability to quickly learn and navigate diverse annotation platforms and tools.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content.
  • Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles.


What We Offer:

  • An innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
  • Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements.
  • Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology.


Join iMerit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of

Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage

you to apply!

title: Video Editor
description:
Vacancy: Video Editor


❗How to apply

Please make sure to complete the form and apply for this position using the Easy Apply button on LinkedIn as well - otherwise, your application will not be considered.


About Us:

Prime Insights is a Sweden-based technology company reaching millions of diverse users through our proprietary Market Research Panel. Our innovative technology supports our international community and gives our members a world-class survey taking experience.

Our mission is to match our authentic members to our client's market research surveys which allows our clients to achieve meaningful insights from the sample we deliver via online quantitative research. Members are rewarded with meaningful incentives, ensuring their sincere participation.


We run mobile app brands at scale — EarnStar, TopSurveys, PrimeOpinion and more. Our ads live on Meta, TikTok, AppLovin and beyond. We are looking for a sharp editor who gets the difference between content that scrolls past and content that converts.


Responsibilities:

  • Edit UGC footage into high-performing paid ads (15s, 30s, 60s cuts)
  • Build hook variants and iterate fast based on performance data
  • Handle formatting across aspect ratios — 9:16, 1:1, 16:9
  • Work from briefs and scripts, then own the cut
  • Keep delivery consistent and on-schedule across multiple brands


Must Have

  • You have 2+ years editing performance ads — UGC, app, or DTC
  • You're comfortable in Capcut, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve/After Effects
  • You understand pacing, retention, and hook mechanics — not just aesthetics
  • You can handle feedback cleanly and turn revisions fast
  • You're remote-ready and communicate proactively


Nice to have

  • Experience with motion graphics or text animation
  • Familiarity with mobile app or rewarded app verticals
  • You've worked in a high-volume, fast-turnaround production environment


The setup

  • Fully remote — work from wherever
  • Async-first with overlap on Central European hours preferred
  • Contract or full-time depending on fit
  • Competitive pay based on experience and output




Important Notice

❗We are not considering freelancers or consultants managing multiple projects . This is a full-time position .

❗Please do not contact team members directly regarding this vacancy. If you are interested, simply apply through the official job posting or contact the HR team directly .

title: Arquiteto Java
description:
Arquiteto Java Sênior

Estamos em busca de um Arquiteto Java qualificado para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal terá uma sólida experiência em desenvolvimento e arquitetura de software, além de ser capaz de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico que abrange tanto projetos legados quanto modernos.


Responsabilidades:

- Atuar na arquitetura e design de soluções em Java, abrangendo versões que variam da 6 à 21, dependendo do projeto.

- Desenvolver e manter aplicações em um ambiente de nuvem utilizando OpenShift da Red Hat.

- Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes de UX/UI e front-end, especialmente em projetos modernos baseados em Spring Boot, enquanto lida com aplicações legadas que utilizam JSF.

- Projetar e implementar APIs, incluindo SOAP e REST, assegurando a observabilidade e a eficiência das soluções.

- Participar da atualização de versões do Java e no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, de acordo com as necessidades dos projetos.

- Aplicar princípios de System Design e Arquitetura de Software para criar soluções escaláveis e sustentáveis.

- Ser receptivo a feedbacks construtivos e trabalhar de maneira colaborativa com diferentes equipes.


Requisitos:

- Sólidos conhecimentos em Java e Spring Boot (fundamental).

- Experiência em design de sistemas e arquitetura de software.

- Familiaridade com microsserviços e sua implementação.

- Capacidade de trabalhar com observabilidade e monitoramento de aplicações.

- Habilidades de comunicação e colaboração, com abertura para receber e implementar feedbacks.


Diferenciais:

- Conhecimento em front-end com React

- Familiaridade com Angular

About Us

Prime Insights connects millions of users worldwide through our proprietary market research panel apps. Our technology powers a global community, delivering a world-class experience for members and actionable, data-driven insights for clients.

We’re building the next generation of our product ecosystem with AI at its core. Our mission is simple: use cutting-edge technology to create better user experiences and smarter business outcomes. We move fast, experiment often, and value people who build, test, and iterate.


Overview

We run a portfolio of rewarded apps used by millions of people, and we use AI to produce the creative that acquires them. We're looking for someone who sees AI tools the way a craftsperson sees their workshop — not as a shortcut, but as a way to make better things faster. You'll produce across formats: playable ads, UGC videos, animated gameplays, motion graphics, and statics. The through-line is taste. The output is yours.


What you'll produce

  • Playable ads - HTML5 interactive ads via our in-house AI generator
  • UGC video - AI-generated or AI-directed scripts, hooks, and edits
  • Animated gameplay - motion-based app demo ads and screen recordings
  • Statics & motion - banner ads, animated creatives, app store assets


What you'll own

  • Generating and art directing assets across formats using AI image, video, and motion tools
  • Running our playable ad generator - concepting mechanics, reviewing output, shipping network variants
  • Maintaining quality across a high volume of creative - knowing when something is ready and when it needs another pass
  • Staying sharp on what's working - feeding performance signals back into your creative decisions


You might be a fit if

  • You have a strong visual sensibility - you notice when something's slightly off and you fix it before anyone asks
  • You're fluent with AI creative tools - different LLM’s, Veo3, NanoBanana, Runway, Kling, Sora, or whatever's best for a specific task in hand
  • You've made things across multiple formats - not just one medium - and you can show us the decisions behind them
  • You're comfortable owning output end-to-end in a small, fast-moving team


Your Background

You come from a creative discipline - video editing, motion design, graphic design, art direction, or something adjacent. You know what good looks like because you've spent time making things, not just prompting things. AI tools are an extension of that craft, not a replacement for it.

  • Video editor — you understand pacing, hooks, and what makes a cut land
  • Motion designer or animator — you have a feel for timing, transitions, and visual rhythm
  • Graphic designer or art director — you compose, you direct, you know when to stop
  • Any combination of the above — the through-line is a trained eye


Nice to have

  • Background in mobile gaming, casual apps, or performance marketing creative
  • Familiarity with UA networks — AppLovin, Meta, TikTok, Google UAC
  • Some comfort reading or debugging HTML and JavaScript


Important Notice

❗We are not considering freelancers or consultants managing multiple projects . This is a full-time position .

❗Please do not contact team members directly regarding this vacancy. If you are interested, simply apply through the official job posting or contact the HR team directly .

title: Head of Professional Services (SaaS)
description:
A Jorni está apoiando uma scale-up em alto crescimento na tarefa de encontrar a pessoa para ocupar a posição de Head of Professional Services. Sobre a vaga e a empresa abaixo.



**



Sobre a Empresa

Somos uma scale-up de tecnologia SaaS B2B em fase de alto crescimento. Operamos em um ambiente dinâmico, de estrutura organizacional horizontal, focado em inovação tecnológica e atendimento a contas de nível Enterprise. Nossa plataforma utiliza Inteligência Artificial e integrações complexas para gerar eficiência e previsibilidade na operação de grandes clientes.


O Desafio

A posição de Head de Professional Services é um pilar estratégico para a expansão do negócio. Quem assumir este papel terá a missão executiva de liderar a operação de implantação de tecnologia, sendo a principal liderança responsável por garantir um Go-Live ágil, reduzir o Time-to-Value (TTV) e transformar a área de implantação em uma linha de receita rentável e escalável para a empresa.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Professional Services e Monetização: Estruturar propostas de escopo de trabalho (SOW), precificar pacotes de serviços de implantação, gerenciar o P&L da área e garantir a entrega de projetos complexos respeitando as margens financeiras estabelecidas.
  • Liderança e Escala de Times: Gerenciar e desenvolver outros líderes e liderados (coordenadores/gerentes/analistas), orquestrando uma equipe multidisciplinar direta e indireta com mais de 10 pessoas (incluindo arquitetos de solução, gerentes de projeto e analistas).
  • Orquestração Técnica e Arquitetural: Liderar tecnicamente as agendas de implantação em contas Enterprise, conduzindo discussões com áreas de tecnologia de clientes sobre integrações via APIs REST, Webhooks e grandes ERPs.
  • Métricas de SaaS: Proteger o negócio contra o churn de onboarding, alinhando as entregas de projetos às métricas de subscrição B2B (LTV, CAC, TTV) e retenção de receita.
  • Inovação e IA: Liderar a implantação de módulos complexos do produto, incluindo soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial Generativa e LLMs.
  • Governança e Processos: Construir e adaptar fluxos de entrega e rituais operacionais que suportem o crescimento acelerado, mantendo a flexibilidade exigida por uma scale-up de estrutura horizontal.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Gestão Executiva: Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em cargos de gestão formal, com histórico comprovado no gerenciamento de outros gestores e administração de orçamentos (P&L).
  • Cultura Scale-up: Vivência prévia na construção e adaptação de processos do zero em startups ou scale-ups de alto crescimento.
  • Domínio de SaaS B2B: Profundo conhecimento das métricas de negócios baseados em assinaturas recorrentes (TTV, Churn, LTV, CAC).
  • Profundidade Técnica: Capacidade arquitetural avançada para discutir viabilidade e desenhar integrações de sistemas (APIs, JSON, Webhooks, bancos de dados, ERPs) diretamente com executivos técnicos (CTOs) de clientes Enterprise.
  • Conhecimento em IA: Vivência prática com projetos tecnológicos que envolvam a implantação de soluções de Inteligência Artificial e LLMs.
  • Delivery e Projetos: Especialidade na operação de implantação corporativa, com foco em gestão de cronogramas críticos, mitigação de riscos e monetização do serviço prestado.


Perfil Comportamental Desejado

Buscamos uma liderança pragmática e direcionada a resultados, com facilidade para transitar entre conversas estratégicas de negócios no C-Level e discussões arquiteturais profundas. É essencial ter resiliência para lidar com ambientes de incerteza e habilidade para simplificar cenários de alta complexidade tecnológica para grandes clientes.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)


About Sisense

Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.


With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence and the Intelligence Assistant, we are accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.


The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts. You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance.


Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense’s growth in embedded AI analytics.


About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning.


Requirements

  • 3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred).
  • Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships.
  • Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio.
  • Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus).
  • Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.


How You’ll Ramp

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team’s revenue retention and growth goals.


What We Offer

  • Employment through a partner agency (B2B).
  • Competitive base salary up to USD 3,500 per month (depending on experience).
  • Eligibility for a quarterly performance bonus.
  • Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics.
  • Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team.
  • Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

title: Analista Pleno de Avaliação Econômica
description:
A Aldelia é uma multinacional franco-inglesa com foco em soluções de RH e terceirização de serviços. Atuante em diversos mercados, principalmente no setor de Óleo e Gás

Nosso cliente, uma grande servidora do segmento de produção e exploração de petróleo, está em busca de um(a) Analista Pleno de Avaliação Econômica para atuar na análise de viabilidade de projetos na indústria de Óleo & Gás. Este(a) profissional será responsável por desenvolver modelos financeiros, interpretar resultados e apoiar decisões estratégicas relacionadas ao portfólio de investimentos da companhia .

Esta é uma posição CLT, terceirizada com a Aldelia, para um contrato de tempo indeterminado com nosso cliente. O escritório da empresa fica na Zona Sul do Rio de Janeiro e atuação será em modelo híbrido (3x2).


Responsabilidades

  • Elaborar e atualizar modelos econômico-financeiros para projetos de exploração, desenvolvimento, produção e descomissionamento.
  • Avaliar a viabilidade de investimentos utilizando indicadores como VPL, TIR, Payback e análises de sensibilidade.
  • Preparar análises e recomendações para comitês de investimento.
  • Consolidar premissas técnicas e econômicas em parceria com áreas como Reservatórios, Engenharia, Planejamento e Comercial.
  • Garantir aderência às regulamentações da ANP, regras fiscais e políticas internas de governança.
  • Apoiar melhorias contínuas nos modelos, bases de dados e processos de avaliação econômica.


Requisitos

  • Graduação obrigatória em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em modelagem financeira e avaliação de investimentos.
  • Domínio de Excel avançado (funções, estruturação de modelos e automações).
  • Conhecimento de metodologias como fluxo de caixa descontado, análise de sensibilidade e cenários.
  • Entendimento do mercado de Óleo & Gás, regimes fiscais e dinâmica de custos da indústria.


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Pós‑graduação ou MBA em Finanças, Economia, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Cursos complementares em modelagem financeira, avaliação de investimentos ou análises de risco.
  • Power BI e ferramentas de IA será um diferencial.
  • Espanhol intermediário será um diferencial.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer - Styleframes & Brand Assets


Company: ContentGrow

Location: Remote (EST)

Hours: Part-Time, Full-Time or Freelance

Payment: $8 / hour or per-task pricing


About ContentGrow


ContentGrow is a creative studio specializing in Web3, AI, tech, SaaS, and gaming. We work closely with clients to create stunning graphics, illustrations, and videos that align with their goals and help their brands stand out. We blend creativity, on-time delivery, and a full-stack design approach to deliver impactful solutions in fast-paced industries.


Our Mission? To give every company the 'digital gravity' that pulls in their ideal user.


Why Join ContentGrow?


  • Be a part of a wide variety of projects, offering new challenges, creative opportunities & keeping your work stimulating.
  • Take on clearly defined projects while having a direct say in design decisions that impact brand direction.
  • Benefit from a steady workload and reliable schedule, providing stability that freelancers rarely get.
  • Opportunity to develop into a design lead role, guiding creative direction and mentoring future team members.
  • Hone your design expertise and expand your skillset in a fast paced work environment.
  • Potential for performance bonuses and possible revenue pool share


What You'll Work On


  • Social Media Graphics (images, ads, stories)
  • Brand Kits & Logos
  • Presentations & Pitch Decks
  • One-Pagers & Infographics
  • Blog Images & Covers
  • Video Thumbnails & Event Banners
  • Video Styleframes & Storyboards
  • Landing Page Designs & Moodboards
  • Website UI Components & Iconography
  • Marketing Materials & Portfolio Posts
  • …and more as our brand and client needs evolve


Key Responsibilities


Design Production


  • Develop compelling visuals for both client projects and our internal brands.
  • Create high-quality styleframes for motion graphics projects that establish visual direction.
  • Design storyboards that effectively communicate animation concepts and flow.
  • Maintain structured file management and naming conventions for organized collaboration.
Project & Workflow Management


  • Manage your production queue of tasks, delivering on time or communicating proactively if delays arise.
  • Juggle multiple projects simultaneously without compromising on quality.


Collaboration & Communication


  • Collaborate with our strategic internal team to understand creative briefings, goals, and visual direction.
  • Offer expert design insights to elevate each project's creative output.
  • Remain available on Telegram during your working hours, responding within 10 minutes.


Feedback & Continuous Improvement


  • Embrace constructive feedback and perform revisions to meet or exceed quality standards.
  • Commit to always learning and refining design techniques, staying updated on industry developments.


Reporting & Process Adherence


  • Log daily task progress (time spent, status updates, etc.).
  • Provide concise end-of-day updates to the team.
  • Uphold our internal processes and suggest improvements as the company grows.


What We're Looking For


Qualifications


  • 2-3 years of experience in graphic design and branding
  • Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma.
  • Experience creating styleframes and storyboards for motion graphics projects
  • Strong understanding of design fundamentals (typography, layout, color theory).
  • Proven experience crafting brand and marketing assets.
  • Good verbal and excellent written communication skills in English.
  • Self-motivated high agency person with a commitment to excellence that takes pride in their work.
  • Required: Motion graphics styleframe design experience
  • Bonus: Motion Graphics or Animation experience
  • Bonus: Web design experience (responsive layouts, UI components, site mockups)
  • Bonus: Product design experience (interface design, user flows, prototyping)
  • Bonus: Familiarity with Web3, AI, SaaS, or other emerging industries.


Values


  • Accountability: Take ownership of your work and follow through on deadlines.
  • Impactful: Create designs that drive real results and leave a lasting impression.
  • Innovator: Push boundaries with creative ideas and fresh design approaches.
  • Attention to detail: Every design decision, from spacing to typography, is intentional.
  • Communicative: Stay responsive, give and receive constructive feedback, and communicate with clarity.


Interview Process


  • Complete a short online skill test
  • Complete a simple creative test task (including styleframe creation)
  • Interview with the founders


How to Apply


Send your portfolio, resume, and a brief message about why you'd be a great fit. Include examples that highlight your range (branding, social media graphics, web designs, motion graphics styleframes ).

title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

REMOTO

description:

About the client

  • A global leader in weather data and forecasting, providing advanced analytics, AI-driven insights, and digital media solutions.
  • Offers high-volume weather data and tools that help individuals, businesses, and brands make informed decisions.
  • Operates large-scale digital platforms reaching hundreds of enterprise clients and millions of users worldwide.
  • Focuses on scalable, privacy-forward data solutions across web and mobile ecosystems.


About the role

This role involves leading consumer data initiatives, focusing on data collection, quality, and usability across digital platforms. You will bridge business analytics needs with technical data infrastructure, ensuring accurate and reliable data for reporting and machine learning.

The position requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams, including product, engineering, and analytics. You will oversee data tracking systems, governance frameworks, and continuous improvements in data processes. The role also includes guiding teams and ensuring high standards in data integrity and accessibility.



Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders (product, marketing, content managers) to translate business analytics requirements into technical specifications.
  • Work with enterprise data architects to define data plans, tracking requirements, and specifications for analytics.
  • Partner with front-end developers to implement event tracking systems.
  • Review and approve tracking implementations to ensure consistency and accuracy.
  • Guide data quality analysts to investigate and resolve data issues.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, BI engineers, and analytics teams to ensure data usability.
  • Establish and maintain data quality standards and governance frameworks.
  • Design and implement data validation processes for consumer behavioral data.
  • Develop automated data quality checks and alerting systems (e.g., dashboards).
  • Establish best practices for data instrumentation across web and mobile applications.
  • Lead the design and implementation of consumer data collection frameworks.
  • Drive continuous improvements in data infrastructure and processes.
  • Ensure data lineage documentation and metadata management.



Must have skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics, software engineering, or related roles.
  • 3+ years of experience managing consumer data from digital applications and websites.
  • 5+ years of Program Management experience
  • Strong proficiency in SQL.
  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server).
  • Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB).
  • Knowledge of customer data platforms (CDPs) and data collection methods (SDKs, cookies, pixels, APIs).
  • Experience with event tracking frameworks and multi-partner integrations.
  • Understanding of web and mobile analytics tools (Amplitude, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Mixpanel).
  • Understanding of data privacy regulations.
  • Knowledge of A/B testing frameworks and experimentation platforms.
  • Experience with cloud data lake solutions (AWS S3, Glue, Athena, Azure Data Lake, Google Cloud Storage, BigQuery).
  • Proven experience leading technical teams and cross-functional projects.
  • Strong communication skills to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Front-end experience in mobile and web development (2+ years).
  • Organized with excellent communication skills.
  • Willingness to complete a background check.



Conditions

  • 100% Remote role, primary timezone UTC-4, with at least 6 hours overlap required.
  • Contractor role, 3-month contract, renewable.
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).
  • Device provided by the client (no BYOD required).

title: Business Analyst
description:
The Business Analyst will work closely with the Product Owner on a daily basis, supporting the structuring, detailing, and communication of requirements and serving as an extension of the PO within the squad. This professional will help translate business needs into clear, actionable backlog items and ensure alignment between stakeholders and the delivery team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the right hand of the Product Owner, providing continuous support in backlog management and requirement definition.
  • Support the PO in the creation, refinement, and maintenance of Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria, ensuring clarity and business value.
  • Prepare and support backlog refinement sessions, ensuring stories are well‑defined, estimated, prioritized, and ready for development.
  • Serve as a key point of support for the squad to clarify requirements, scope, and dependencies on behalf of the PO.
  • Manage and maintain artifacts using JIRA (backlog, stories, tasks, progress tracking) and Confluence (documentation, specifications, and decisions).
  • Support Agile ceremonies such as Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
  • Lead Agile ceremonies when necessary, especially in the PO’s absence or when additional facilitation is required.
  • Ensure alignment between business expectations and the squad’s delivery capabilities.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst supporting Product Owners in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Strong expertise in writing and refining Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria.
  • Hands‑on experience with JIRA and Confluence.
  • Solid understanding of Agile principles and frameworks (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills.
  • Ability to act autonomously as PO support while maintaining close alignment with the Product Owner.
  • Detail‑oriented, proactive, and delivery‑focused mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience acting as a proxy or delegate for the Product Owner.
  • Experience supporting cross‑functional or distributed Agile teams.

title: Suporte Técnico de Inversor Fotovoltaico
description:

Atendimento Técnico


1. Conhecimento dos inversores: É importante ter experiência com inversor, incluindo o entendimento de seus recursos, configurações, parâmetros e modos de operação.

4. Habilidades de comunicação: Além do conhecimento técnico, é importante ter boas habilidades de comunicação para interagir com os clientes, entender suas necessidades, explicar soluções de problemas e fornecer suporte adequado. Isso inclui a capacidade de se comunicar claramente, ouvir atentamente e ser paciente.

title: Analista de RevOps
description:
Junte-se à transformação da saúde no Brasil com a Salux Technology!


A Salux Technology é uma HealthTech 100% brasileira pioneira em soluções inovadoras de gestão de saúde. Desde 1997, nossa missão tem sido democratizar a excelência em saúde, ajudando mais de 250 clientes em todo o país a alcançar resultados excepcionais ao aprimorar a gestão administrativa e clínica.


Em 2021, a Salux passou a fazer parte do Grupo SBPar, o que acelerou nossa jornada de expansão e inovação, consolidando nossa posição como referência em excelência na informatização e soluções tecnológicas para o setor de saúde.


Se você é movido por desafios e quer fazer a diferença em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante evolução, venha crescer conosco e impactar positivamente o futuro da saúde no Brasil!


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Estruturar e otimizar a operação de Revenue Operations, garantindo eficiência e previsibilidade de receita;
  • Mapear e evoluir o funil ponta a ponta (pipeline, fechamento, onboarding, retenção e expansão);
  • Padronizar processos entre Vendas e Customer Success e identificar oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Implementar automações ao longo da jornada do cliente, aumentando produtividade e reduzindo atividades manuais;
  • Integrar ferramentas (CRM, CS, BI) garantindo consistência e qualidade dos dados;
  • Acompanhar e estruturar indicadores de receita (conversão, churn, NRR, LTV, CAC) e apoiar forecast;
  • Desenvolver dashboards e gerar insights para tomada de decisão;

title: AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese Fluency
description:
AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese Fluency


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The role

We’re looking for Advanced Japanese Speakers to help train and evaluate cutting-edge AI models. If you have the necessary experience, we’ll send you a quick test to assess your skills and suitability for AI tasks. If successful, you’ll be invited to join Prolific as a Domain Expert participant, where you’ll get paid to train and evaluate powerful AI models.


Researchers looking for your skills tend to pay $20-30/hr per AI task completed. You must be prepared to complete paid tasks that require one hour of uninterrupted work, though many are shorter.


What you’ll bring

  • Advanced language skills and verifiable experience as being fluent in Japanese.
  • Fluency in English (B2+)
  • A willingness to take our skills verification test to assess your suitability for our Domain Expert participant pool
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to concentrate on complex tasks for up to one hour at a time
  • A reliable and fast internet connection and access to a computer
  • A willingness to self-declare your earnings, as our participants are self-employed
  • A Paypal account to receive payment from our clients


What you’ll be doing in the role

  • Completing AI training tasks such as analyzing, editing, and writing in Japanese
  • Judging the performance of AI in performing Japanese prompts
  • Improving cutting-edge AI models


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
About us:

Closir is a UK-based investor relations (IR) support services provider. For over a decade we have been entrusted by blue chip companies around the world to help them achieve their IR objectives due to our intimate knowledge of the global buy-side, our technological expertise, and our close, long-term partnership approach.

The Closir platform is an all-in-one, web-based solution which makes companies much smarter and more effective, by helping them to achieve their IR objectives intelligently and proactively.

Closir combines all elements of IR, from high-level strategy (“Who’s investing in my peers?”) to daily workflow (“What topics came up most in my meetings with investors this quarter?”) into one intelligent, user-friendly platform which includes the most comprehensive and up-to-date database of buy-side contacts on the market; proactive outreach tools; share & peer holder tracking; customisable reports; and professional-level support.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a customer-centric, self-driven individual to join our Customer Success team.


You will manage relationships with IR teams at public companies, guiding them from onboarding through to long-term adoption. You’ll help clients integrate their data, extract insights, and embed Closir into their day-to-day workflows.


You will work closely with Research and Product teams to ensure high-quality data integration, surface client feedback, and improve the experience on Closir.com.


Responsibilities:


  • Partner with clients to understand their Investor Relations needs and drive adoption of the Closir platform.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, providing strategic insights and support to senior IR teams.
  • Deliver tailored onboarding, training, and consulting sessions.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to champion client feedback and influence product direction.
  • Build long-lasting relationships that foster retention, growth, and client advocacy.



Qualifications:


  • Background in Investor Relations (in-house or advisory) – you understand the workflows, challenges, and priorities of IR professionals.
  • Experience in consulting, customer success, or client-facing roles where you’ve advised senior stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex needs into actionable solutions.
  • Passion for SaaS, fintech, and improving how companies engage with investors.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish



Why Join Us?


  • Work at the intersection of SaaS, finance, and strategy with a fast-growing, global team.
  • Shape the future of investor relations technology.
  • Opportunity to take ownership and make a measurable impact with clients.
  • Collaborative, ambitious, and supportive culture.



If you’re excited about helping Investor Relations teams thrive with cutting-edge SaaS solutions, we’d love to hear from you.


This job vacancy is open for candidates based out of Latin America.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About Turnkey

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software.

The TurnKey team is growing fast and worldwide! We have employees located in Eastern European countries and Latin America (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Uruguay). We continue scaling remote software development teams for more than 30+ US-based enterprises and start-ups, including Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, Ironclad, BellXcel, etc. At TurnKey, we’re the ultimate matchmakers for US-based companies, creating remote dream teams.


Role Overview

We’re looking for a driven and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our growing team. You will play a key role in sourcing and recruiting top tech and non-tech talent across Europe and Latin America , partnering closely with hiring managers and candidates to ensure an excellent recruitment experience from start to finish.


Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with internal teams and clients to understand hiring needs and role requirements
  • Source, screen, and engage candidates for a variety of technical and non-technical roles
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment: job posting, sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, collecting feedback, and offer negotiation
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-demand positions
  • Ensure a smooth and timely candidate experience, keeping stakeholders informed throughout the process
  • Collaborate with team members and hiring managers to continuously improve processes
  • Maintain accurate data in our applicant tracking systems and internal reports
  • Stay updated on regional hiring trends and market insights across Europe and LATAM


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Strong knowledge of IT roles, technologies, and industry trends.
  • Familiarity with both technical and non-technical profiles
  • Solid sourcing skills and experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and other sourcing tools
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
  • Upper-Intermediate + level of English
  • Readiness to work in various time zones according to the candidates’ time zone


Why You Should Work at TurnKey:

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team.
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks);
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget.

  • Fully Remote work;

  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together.

title: Product Owner Pleno (PO)
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um(a) Super Product Owner Pleno , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Produtos e que queria crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades:

Estratégia e visão de produto

  • Contribuir para a definição da visão do produto e alinhamento com stakeholders;
  • Identificar problemas relevantes e oportunidades de melhoria baseadas em dados e feedback de usuários;
  • Priorizar iniciativas alinhadas aos OKRs trimestrais.


Discovery e validação de soluções

  • Conduzir discovery contínuo para entendimento profundo de problemas e necessidades;
  • Criar e validar hipóteses de solução antes da implementação em escala;
  • Construir ou apoiar a construção de MVPs rápidos utilizando ferramentas de IA, prototipação e low-code;
  • Testar soluções com usuários antes de direcionar o time de engenharia.


Gestão do produto e delivery

  • Criar épicos e histórias de usuário bem estruturadas, com critérios de aceite claros;
  • Gerir backlog upstream e downstream;
  • Priorizar e refinar demandas com o time de tecnologia;
  • Orientar o time sobre regras de negócio e objetivos das entregas;
  • Avaliar e aceitar entregas garantindo aderência aos critérios definidos.


Colaboração com o time

  • Trabalhar próximo aos times de UX, Engenharia e Dados;
  • Participar de rituais do time (dailys, refinamentos, planning e retrospectivas);
  • Garantir clareza de contexto e objetivos para o time multidisciplinar.


Gestão por dados

  • Monitorar métricas de produto e comportamento do usuário;
  • Utilizar dados para validar hipóteses e apoiar decisões de produto;
  • Conduzir experimentos (A/B tests, testes de solução, validações rápidas).


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida atuando como Product Manager ou Product Owner;
  • Forte habilidade de priorização de backlog;
  • Experiência com Discovery e Delivery de produto;
  • Capacidade de estruturar histórias de usuário, critérios de aceite e cenários;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis como Scrum e Kanban;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de produto (Jira, Miro ou similares);
  • Experiência com análise de dados de produto (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics, HubSpot ou similares);
  • Experiência com testes e experimentação em produtos digitais;
  • Experiência com métricas de produto digital.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em estatística ou ciência de dados;
  • Noções de arquitetura e stacks de tecnologia (backend, web, app, infraestrutura);
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou marketplaces;
  • Experiência em startups;
  • Experiência com prototipação rápida e ferramentas de construção low-code / IA.


O que esperamos dessa pessoa:

  • Forte orientação a resolver problemas reais dos usuários ;
  • Mentalidade data-driven ;
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões com autonomia e responsabilidade ;
  • Perfil mão na massa , confortável em testar soluções rapidamente;
  • Curiosidade e abertura para trabalhar com IA e novas ferramentas de construção de produto ;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de colaboração com times multidisciplinares.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Project Manager - Digital Technology
description:
Project Manager - Digital Technology


Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Digital Technology (DT) Project Manager to join our team. The DT Project Manager will be responsible for planning, leading, organizing, and motivating project teams to achieve a high level of performance and quality in delivering projects that provide exceptional business value to users. This role requires a high degree of collaboration with leaders across the organization.

  • Key Responsibilities:Project Planning and Management: Full project life cycle ownership: successful project delivery will include full implementation from initiation to deployment.


  • Scope, Schedule, and Resource Management: Manage all aspects of projects including scope, schedule, resources, quality, costs, change, and risk to ensure the overall program is aligned to and directly supports the achievement of strategic objectives.


  • Financial Management: Oversee project budgets, track expenditures, and ensure financial objectives are met. Provide regular financial reports and forecasts to stakeholders.


  • Project Monitoring & Control: Prepare estimates and detailed project plan for all phases of the project. Manage the day-to-day project activities and resources.


  • Transparency and Reporting: Provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverable, dependencies, risks & issues, communicating across leadership.


  • Agile Practices: Organize and facilitate release planning, daily stand-up meetings, and reviews. Track and communicate scrum metrics including team velocity and sprint/release progress.


  • Quality Management: Manage ongoing quality control and participate in quality issue resolution.


  • Risk Management: Identify and manage project risks and issues, and develop mitigation plans
  • Experience and Skills: Experience in Agile & Waterfall methodologies.


  • Excellent communication (written, verbal and presentation) and interpersonal skills.


  • Experience in successfully leading projects and programs to from initiation to closure.


  • Experience working both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.


  • Experience partnering with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and technical teams.


  • Flexible with proven ability to conform to shifting priorities, demands and timelines through analytical and problem-solving capabilities.


  • Flexible work hours when needed to align with counterparts at other Otis locations.


  • Support diverse and inclusive work environment.


  • Bachelor's Degree of Computer Science, IT, MIS or equivalent work experience.


  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on project management experience, including initiating, tracking and planning projects.


  • Intermediate level of proficiency with MS Office, MS Project, PPM and Agile tools.


  • PMP Certification required. Agile certifications are highly desirable

title: Product Owner
description:
A Airswift está com uma nova oportunidade para Product Owner, para atuar em um cliente global do setor de energia, em aplicações utilizadas por times de negócios em diferentes regiões do mundo.


Sobre a posição

O profissional será responsável por apoiar a transição e sustentação de duas aplicações.

Essas aplicações estão em um plano de descontinuação e, portanto, o foco da posição será:

  • Suporte operacional
  • Manutenção
  • Estabilidade das aplicações
  • Apoio à transição para futuras soluções que irão substituí-las
  • Não haverá desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades.


Responsabilidades

  • Criar user stories e critérios de aceite claros e completos.
  • Priorizar e manter o backlog alinhado à visão do produto e ao roadmap.
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time na entrega.
  • Colaborar com arquitetos e times técnicos na definição de demandas técnicas e de infraestrutura.
  • Balancear entregas, dívida técnica e melhorias necessárias.
  • Garantir que as entregas gerem valor real ao negócio.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o Delivery Team e o Scrum Master no planejamento e execução.
  • Atuar como a voz do cliente, entendendo continuamente as necessidades do negócio.
  • Interagir com usuários para análise de demandas e alinhamento de expectativas.
  • Apoiar o Program Team em roadmap e planos de release.
  • Colaborar com outros Product Owners para gerenciamento de dependências.
  • Proteger o time de interrupções fora de escopo durante os sprints.
  • Criar e gerenciar tickets de atendimento para clientes finais.


Requisitos

  • Experiência como Product Owner
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis .
  • Inglês avançado/fluente – todas as interações serão realizadas em inglês.
  • Forte capacidade de:
  • Entendimento do negócio
  • Comunicação clara
  • Experiência ou familiaridade com:
  • Zendesk
  • Amazon Connect
  • Sistemas internos / soluções customizadas (diferencial)

Modelo de trabalho

  • Híbrido, caso profissional seja de Curitiba (diferencial) ou Remoto
  • Horário: 8h às 17h
  • Início: previsão final de Março 2026

title: Product Owner Pleno (PO)
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um(a) Super Product Owner Pleno , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Produtos e que queria crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades:

Estratégia e visão de produto

  • Contribuir para a definição da visão do produto e alinhamento com stakeholders;
  • Identificar problemas relevantes e oportunidades de melhoria baseadas em dados e feedback de usuários;
  • Priorizar iniciativas alinhadas aos OKRs trimestrais.


Discovery e validação de soluções

  • Conduzir discovery contínuo para entendimento profundo de problemas e necessidades;
  • Criar e validar hipóteses de solução antes da implementação em escala;
  • Construir ou apoiar a construção de MVPs rápidos utilizando ferramentas de IA, prototipação e low-code;
  • Testar soluções com usuários antes de direcionar o time de engenharia.


Gestão do produto e delivery

  • Criar épicos e histórias de usuário bem estruturadas, com critérios de aceite claros;
  • Gerir backlog upstream e downstream;
  • Priorizar e refinar demandas com o time de tecnologia;
  • Orientar o time sobre regras de negócio e objetivos das entregas;
  • Avaliar e aceitar entregas garantindo aderência aos critérios definidos.


Colaboração com o time

  • Trabalhar próximo aos times de UX, Engenharia e Dados;
  • Participar de rituais do time (dailys, refinamentos, planning e retrospectivas);
  • Garantir clareza de contexto e objetivos para o time multidisciplinar.


Gestão por dados

  • Monitorar métricas de produto e comportamento do usuário;
  • Utilizar dados para validar hipóteses e apoiar decisões de produto;
  • Conduzir experimentos (A/B tests, testes de solução, validações rápidas).


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida atuando como Product Manager ou Product Owner;
  • Forte habilidade de priorização de backlog;
  • Experiência com Discovery e Delivery de produto;
  • Capacidade de estruturar histórias de usuário, critérios de aceite e cenários;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis como Scrum e Kanban;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de produto (Jira, Miro ou similares);
  • Experiência com análise de dados de produto (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics, HubSpot ou similares);
  • Experiência com testes e experimentação em produtos digitais;
  • Experiência com métricas de produto digital.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em estatística ou ciência de dados;
  • Noções de arquitetura e stacks de tecnologia (backend, web, app, infraestrutura);
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou marketplaces;
  • Experiência em startups;
  • Experiência com prototipação rápida e ferramentas de construção low-code / IA.


O que esperamos dessa pessoa:

  • Forte orientação a resolver problemas reais dos usuários ;
  • Mentalidade data-driven ;
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões com autonomia e responsabilidade ;
  • Perfil mão na massa , confortável em testar soluções rapidamente;
  • Curiosidade e abertura para trabalhar com IA e novas ferramentas de construção de produto ;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de colaboração com times multidisciplinares.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.



O que oferecemos:

title: Project Manager - Digital Technology
description:
Project Manager - Digital Technology


Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Digital Technology (DT) Project Manager to join our team. The DT Project Manager will be responsible for planning, leading, organizing, and motivating project teams to achieve a high level of performance and quality in delivering projects that provide exceptional business value to users. This role requires a high degree of collaboration with leaders across the organization.

  • Key Responsibilities:Project Planning and Management: Full project life cycle ownership: successful project delivery will include full implementation from initiation to deployment.


  • Scope, Schedule, and Resource Management: Manage all aspects of projects including scope, schedule, resources, quality, costs, change, and risk to ensure the overall program is aligned to and directly supports the achievement of strategic objectives.


  • Financial Management: Oversee project budgets, track expenditures, and ensure financial objectives are met. Provide regular financial reports and forecasts to stakeholders.


  • Project Monitoring & Control: Prepare estimates and detailed project plan for all phases of the project. Manage the day-to-day project activities and resources.


  • Transparency and Reporting: Provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverable, dependencies, risks & issues, communicating across leadership.


  • Agile Practices: Organize and facilitate release planning, daily stand-up meetings, and reviews. Track and communicate scrum metrics including team velocity and sprint/release progress.


  • Quality Management: Manage ongoing quality control and participate in quality issue resolution.


  • Risk Management: Identify and manage project risks and issues, and develop mitigation plans
  • Experience and Skills: Experience in Agile & Waterfall methodologies.


  • Excellent communication (written, verbal and presentation) and interpersonal skills.


  • Experience in successfully leading projects and programs to from initiation to closure.


  • Experience working both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.


  • Experience partnering with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and technical teams.


  • Flexible with proven ability to conform to shifting priorities, demands and timelines through analytical and problem-solving capabilities.


  • Flexible work hours when needed to align with counterparts at other Otis locations.


  • Support diverse and inclusive work environment.


  • Bachelor's Degree of Computer Science, IT, MIS or equivalent work experience.


  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on project management experience, including initiating, tracking and planning projects.


  • Intermediate level of proficiency with MS Office, MS Project, PPM and Agile tools.


  • PMP Certification required. Agile certifications are highly desirable

title: Product Owner
description:
A Airswift está com uma nova oportunidade para Product Owner, para atuar em um cliente global do setor de energia, em aplicações utilizadas por times de negócios em diferentes regiões do mundo.


Sobre a posição

O profissional será responsável por apoiar a transição e sustentação de duas aplicações.

Essas aplicações estão em um plano de descontinuação e, portanto, o foco da posição será:

  • Suporte operacional
  • Manutenção
  • Estabilidade das aplicações
  • Apoio à transição para futuras soluções que irão substituí-las
  • Não haverá desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades.


Responsabilidades

  • Criar user stories e critérios de aceite claros e completos.
  • Priorizar e manter o backlog alinhado à visão do produto e ao roadmap.
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time na entrega.
  • Colaborar com arquitetos e times técnicos na definição de demandas técnicas e de infraestrutura.
  • Balancear entregas, dívida técnica e melhorias necessárias.
  • Garantir que as entregas gerem valor real ao negócio.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o Delivery Team e o Scrum Master no planejamento e execução.
  • Atuar como a voz do cliente, entendendo continuamente as necessidades do negócio.
  • Interagir com usuários para análise de demandas e alinhamento de expectativas.
  • Apoiar o Program Team em roadmap e planos de release.
  • Colaborar com outros Product Owners para gerenciamento de dependências.
  • Proteger o time de interrupções fora de escopo durante os sprints.
  • Criar e gerenciar tickets de atendimento para clientes finais.


Requisitos

  • Experiência como Product Owner
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis .
  • Inglês avançado/fluente – todas as interações serão realizadas em inglês.
  • Forte capacidade de:
  • Entendimento do negócio
  • Comunicação clara
  • Experiência ou familiaridade com:
  • Zendesk
  • Amazon Connect
  • Sistemas internos / soluções customizadas (diferencial)

Modelo de trabalho

  • Híbrido, caso profissional seja de Curitiba (diferencial) ou Remoto
  • Horário: 8h às 17h
  • Início: previsão final de Março 2026

title: Java Developer
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Java Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics and performance management.

- Conform to existing industry security coding standards adhering to fortify scan and other security tool review requirements.

- Conduct code reviews for junior members of the team and do peer code reviews to make sure code is following standards set forward by the architects.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.
